fuel.src: Rwanda Utilities Regulatory Authority (RURA) communiqué of 5 Jun 2026 - maximum retail pump prices (gasoline, diesel), effective 6 Jun 2026
fuel.quote: the maximum retail pump prices for petroleum products are revised to: Gasoline (Petrol) not exceeding 2,938 Frw/L, and Diesel not exceeding 2,927 Frw/L
